findings.text: follow-on: after_suite records completed:true and "737 passed, EXIT=0" for population_head.log, but that log is 13 lines and ends mid-run at "[ 68%]" with no pytest summary line and no finite EXIT= line; the arm was killed at 10:34:36 before finishing, so the manifest's completion claim is not carried by the log it cites.

follow-on: the change deleted two assertions (zero["review"]["status"] == "parsed" and zero["review"]["total"] == 0) from test_a_record_without_a_review_is_distinguishable_from_a_zero_scored_one, leaving that test's own comment ("carries a parsed block with total 0) unverified and reducing coverage unrelated to the sixth dimension.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 3608bb44; the single commit a34b2c15 changes the tuple, the prompt text, the flight-defaults floor, the test fixtures and the evidence fragment, and no production file beyond reckon/crew/review.py and the prompt.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a focused pytest gate plus the wider importing population; the manifest records the gate at "250 passed, EXIT=0" (matched by gate.log:9) and the population at 737/737, whose head log does not carry that figure (see finding).
item_verdicts.goal: the node scores reuse as a sixth review dimension; reckon/crew/review.py:88 adds "reuse" last to REVIEW_DIMENSIONS and reckon/crew/prompts/review.md states its scoring rule, matching the node goal.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the focused gate 250 passed EXIT=0 and the population 737/737, but its after_suite log population_head.log is truncated and carries no pytest summary, so completed:true is not supported by the cited log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths; git diff --name-only 3608bb44e643bb445135f6b78bc9da767d42785e a34b2c15 lists exactly those sixteen paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_ledger.py:922-923 deletes the assertions that a zero-scored review block is parsed with total 0, weakening a guard the sixth dimension did not require touching.
justifications.evidence: the focused gate is recorded and reproduced (gate.log:9 "250 passed ... EXIT=0"), but the after_suite log the manifest names, population_head.log, is incomplete and so the recorded arm overstates its own completion.
justifications.fit: the change adds one entry to the existing REVIEW_DIMENSIONS registry and its mirrored prompt rather than a new module, and introduces no name the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:88 adds "reuse" as the last entry of REVIEW_DIMENSIONS and reckon/crew/prompts/review.md:91 states the reuse scoring rule and the complementary clone detector, exactly as the node goal states.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 3608bb44 a34b2c15 returns exactly the sixteen declared write paths; no file outside them changed.
